generationRulesReview.title: Saved generation rules
generationRulesReview.description: Review the saved rules and their sources before approving this revision. Approval does not verify facts, asset availability or font rendering.
generationRulesReview.acknowledge: I have reviewed the saved generation rules and their sources.
generationRulesReview.unavailable: These saved rules cannot be acknowledged. Reload the revision or correct and save the guide before approving.
generationRulesReview.none: This revision has no saved generation rules.

identityPreview.title: Approved identity preview
identityPreview.savedVersion: Save or discard your changes to view the current approved identity.
identityPreview.unavailable: The current approved identity cannot be shown. This does not mean the brand guide is missing or unapproved.
identityPreview.integrityFailed: The saved identity did not match its recorded details, so it is not shown.
identityPreview.assetsUnavailable: A saved brand asset for this identity is unavailable.
identityPreview.loadFailed: Could not load the current approved identity. Try again.

approvedContent.title: Approved wording and asset text
approvedContent.description: Review the complete wording and the text visible in each saved asset before approving this revision.
approvedContent.selectedLiterals: Only the selected approved wording is visible
approvedContent.assetUnavailable: The exact saved asset is unavailable. Its text inventory cannot be approved.
approvedContent.sourceUnavailable: Supporting evidence is unavailable. Review or replace the source before approval.
approvedContent.manualAttestation: Owner-provided statement; external truth has not been independently verified.
approvedContent.acknowledge: I reviewed this saved revision, its complete wording, supporting facts, and the text inventory of its exact saved assets.
approvedContent.saveFirst: Save your changes, then review the saved revision before approving.
approvedContent.reviewRequired: Review the saved wording and asset text inventory before approving.
approvedContent.reviewChanged: The saved revision changed. Review it again before approving.
approvedContent.reviewLimit: Approval evidence exceeds the guide limits. Reduce the entries and save again.
approvedContent.evidenceRequired: Add supporting evidence before saving this wording or asset inventory.

title: Brand OS revisions and export
description: Review the fields included in each approved version of your brand.

export.unavailable: Approve a revision to create your design.md export.
export.private: Your approved design.md is private. Only organization members can download it.
export.published: A public snapshot is available at the link below. New approvals require an explicit publication update.
export.revoked: Public access has been revoked. Organization members can still download the approved design.md. Publishing again re-enables previously shared stable links.

newRevisions: New revisions are available. Save or discard your edits before refreshing history.
confirmLeave: Leave this page and discard your unsaved Brand OS edits?
approved: Revision {version} approved. New supported brand generation can use this version. Public access changes only when you publish.
downloaded: Your approved design.md has been downloaded.
errorPreserved: {error} Your unsaved edits have been kept.
membersReadOnly: Only organization owners and admins can edit, approve, publish, or revoke revisions.
empty: Scan your website or create a manual draft below to start a revision.
unsaved: Unsaved edits. Save your draft before approving or switching revisions.
publicationOutdated: A newer approved revision is available. Update the publication to share it.
published: Your approved design.md is now public.
revoked: Public access revoked. Member downloads remain available.
candidateHelp: Select candidates to include. Unselected candidates are never exported.
listLimit: Use at most 50 entries per list. Your edits are still available.
exportInvalid: Approved revision cannot be exported. Review required identity and export limits, then save and approve a corrected revision.
scanPersistenceFailed: Website scan succeeded, but the draft could not be saved as a revision. Your scanned fields are still available below.
manualPersistenceFailed: Manual draft created, but it could not be saved as a revision. Your fields are still available below.

policy.title: Publishing Policy
policy.description: What this brand's agents may publish without a member. It takes effect when this revision is approved; until then every autonomous draft waits for review. A member's approval always overrides it.
policy.none: This revision has no Policy, so every autonomous draft waits for review.
policy.invalidTimezone: Unknown timezone. The Policy keeps its last valid timezone.
policy.judgeNote: Banned phrases are matched exactly. Banned topics and claims are checked by a model before an unattended publish, and a draft is held when it cannot be checked.
policy.invalid: This Policy cannot be saved yet: {error}
